title: CFD Forge: A Physics-Constrained Agentic Framework for Autonomous CFD (code)
description: Source code for the CFD Forge preprint ("CFD Forge: A Physics-Constrained Agentic Framework for Autonomous CFD"; arXiv identifier to be added): an OpenFOAM-based agentic framework in which a language model interprets requests, diagnoses simulation evidence and proposes corrective actions from a closed set, while deterministic, family-specific validators decide acceptance. Includes the registered nozzle (axisymmetric 5-degree wedge) and two-dimensional forward-facing-step families, validators, prompts and response schemas, the controller-comparison evidence, and the scripts that produce the paper figures. Archived agent session records, case files and solver logs are deposited as a separate Zenodo dataset.
